title: Mixed Event — Get Fit & Fly! Muscle Training! — Episode2 Shinobi Battle

meta.Event Outline: Haruka thinks of ways to make exercise fun for MORE MORE JUMP!'s fans. By chance, she meets Tsukasa, who invites her to the athletic event Shinobi Battle!

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE - Practice Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
...five, six, seven, eight!
Okay, that was good. Let's stop here!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew... How are you all doing? Were you able to copy what we did?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yup!>
<So tired...>
<You're such a great teacher.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's end our “Everybody MORE MORE DANCE!” segment here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think we all got the hang of that dance now, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Dancing can seem really hard at first, but figuring everything out ends up being so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I hope we've managed to show you how much fun it can be.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That was fun!>
<Please do this segment again.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe. Thank goodness...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This is the first new idea we've incorporated since we decided to put more effort into our streams, so I'm really glad that everyone enjoyed it...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Quite a few are even asking us to do this again. So, we should come up with another dance to...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I never got the hang of it...>
<Haruka looks so much cooler when she does this.>
<How do you stop on a dime like that?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's okay. We can take it one step at a time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not being able to stop when you want may have something to do with your muscle control. Having a good core is really important, so I recommend doing some strength training.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Strength training...? Okay, I'll give a few exercises a try...>
<Thanks, Haruka!>
<I promise to learn to dance it like all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <I'm not very athletic, but I wanna learn to do it like you, Haruka.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
Then, you'll need to put in a little effort every day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll show you some good exercises a little later, so let's do our best to become stronger together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
Here's some water.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, that really hits the spot!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, I was amazed by the response our stream got today. Everyone seemed to really enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Some even asked us to do this again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, but a few also seemed to have trouble following us. Why don't we show everyone how we train during our next stream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good idea. The exercises we do make us better dancers and help keep us in shape, so there should be plenty of interest.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Plus, we need to keep training in order to put on better performances moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually, if we're going to do this, I'd like to get all the proper machines and equipment... But we can discuss that another time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The proper machines and equipment?
It sounds like you're ready to start your own gym...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But...! I'll do what you ask!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna try more and more and more to learn how to perform cool dances like you, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
Then, let's start thinking about incorporating training streams, too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want this to help us become better performers as well, so get ready to have some fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But please don't go too hard on me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Where'd all that motivation from a second ago disappear to?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The others have all been really motivated since we began training for Idol Lovers.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I need to do my best to keep up with them.)
The next day
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What should we do for our next stream?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Based on the comments we received yesterday, quite a few people had trouble learning that dance. That calls for some strength training.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We'll want to do some beginner-friendly exercises with everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hang on... If they're not all that fond of exercising, then they might avoid watching a stream that's all about working out.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What else could we do...?)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <I'm not very athletic, but I wanna learn to do it like you, Haruka.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That person wants to dance like me...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If that feeling is genuine, then it might be better to do slightly more intense drills or exercises.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Something tough, but also fun...
That might get them to take the dive.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But what encompasses both of those things?)
Don't you think that's going a bit too far?
Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(It's those two again. What are the odds?
But they seem to be having a serious discussion about something...)
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good morning.
You're both here very early again.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Oh, Kiritani.
Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good morning!
Out for another run? I admire your diligence!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Likewise.
But is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You two seemed to be having a bit of serious discussion just now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, you saw...
Yes, there is something on our minds.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Have you heard the news?
A new facility is scheduled to open here at Nonogi Park.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I remember hearing something about that. It's supposed to include an obstacle course and an indoor gym, yes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The gym is going to have all the latest machines and equipment. It's even going to have free showers and coin-op lockers.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
That sounds incredible, but is there some sort of catch?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Actually, yes. They're going to hold a special event to celebrate the grand opening the Sunday after next!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's called “Shinobi Battle”!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “Shinobi Battle”...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's an obstacle course race that's open to the public.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Teams of three will be competing to see who can finish it the fastest.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Really?
I didn't hear anything about that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. The course even includes a part of the new athletic area, so we're both very interested.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Overall, it looks very difficult. Each section is designed to test your various muscles.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But that just makes it all the more appetizing.
Apparently, athletes from all over will be gathering to compete.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. The new athletic area...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It sounds like a difficult course, but also fun. And perfect for a stream...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly! This event is apparently held at parks all over that have obstacle courses, and many people always gather both to compete and to watch.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So much so that some out there train specifically with winning this event in mind.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wow indeed. Some of them are so popular that they boast large fan bases. That includes children who see them as their role models!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I know a few guys who started playing sports after seeing it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And then there's what the winners will receive!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The top prize includes...
Premium annual passes to the obstacle course and gym!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
What...?
Premium annual passes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! They even give you anytime access to the gym's premium private rooms!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On top of that, each pass gives entry to up to four people! It's almost too good to be true, no?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Up to four people...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That means Airi, the others and I could use the rooms to train here whenever we like.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Plus, we need to keep training in order to put on better performances moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm gonna try more and more and more to learn how to perform cool dances like you, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I would love to get my hands on that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! We were just thinking the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But we've been having trouble getting a team together.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You have?
I figured Otori and the others would participate for sure...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu and them are all busy that day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We even asked our friends and classmates, but they also turned us down...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be fair, this is a pretty serious course. It makes sense no one wants to jump on board knowing we want to win the thing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right... You would need people who train regularly, who could clear that obstacle course. Not many people come to mind...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, they do! Right here!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you're not talking about...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I most certainly am!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Akito, Kiritani!
Won't you join me?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because you just said to me how that facility could allow you to train in new ways. You seemed genuinely interested in it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And you, Kiritani.
You seem like the type who diligently trains and exercises every day! The three of us would make the perfect team!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
W-Wait, I'm sorry!
I believe that the three of us could surely win... But I wouldn't dream of insisting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I just hope you'll be willing to consider my offer.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You are an idol, after all. You've got a lot to consider, yeah?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(That annual pass is very appealing...
It would be nice to train at this facility with Minori and the others.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But he's right. I'm an idol, so my participation will involve some degree of risk...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Our fans may not enjoy seeing me team up with people they've never seen before.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <I'm not very athletic, but I wanna learn to do it like you, Haruka.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Some of them are so popular that they boast large fan bases. That includes children who see them as their role models!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I know a few guys who started playing sports after seeing it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This event may give me a chance to spread hope to our fans...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I took some time to think about this? I'll need to discuss this with my group before agreeing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
The cutoff for entering isn't for a while, so please feel free to take your time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, I'll let you know once I've reached a decision.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be looking forward to hearing from you!
